ax4.bar([i + width for i in x], df['NumStorePurchases'], width, label='Store', color=colors[2])

ax5.set_xticks(positions)
ax5.set_xticklabels(marital_groups.index)

ax5.set_ylabel('Income')
ax5.set_title('Income by Marital Status', fontweight='bold')

df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']

ax6.set_xlabel('Total Kids at Home')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending')
ax6.set_title('Children at Home vs Total Spending', fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
